parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is a rotation blade of a folding knife made of stainless steel, designed for cutting tasks.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main cutting component of the knife, providing a sharp edge for slicing or cutting materials.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a pivot joint to fold into or out of the handle for safe storage and use.

parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is another rotation blade of the folding knife, also made of stainless steel, functioning similarly to the first blade.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as an alternative or secondary cutting edge, possibly for different cutting styles or safety configurations.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the same pivot mechanism, allowing it to fold into the handle when not in use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or handle of the folding knife, made of aluminum alloy for lightweight durability.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a comfortable grip for the user and houses the pivot mechanism that allows the blade to rotate and lock in place.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the structural support for the rotating blade.
